en.rus_tool_description: Choose a road type and add-ons, then click existing roads to upgrade them in one go.
en.rus_roadType_tooltip: Road type the clicked segments are replaced with.
en.rus_busLane_tooltip: Turn the outermost lane on both sides of the road into a bus lane.
en.rus_tram_tooltip: Lay tram tracks on the outermost lane on both sides of the road. Together with the bus lane, both use the same lane.
en.rus_trees_tooltip: Use the variant of the road type with alley trees. Not available for country roads.
en.rus_barrier_tooltip: Use the variant of the road type with noise barriers.
en.rus_lock_tooltip: Prevent towns from updating or extending the road. A regular upgrade never unlocks a locked road.
en.rus_problem_treesAndBarrier: Alley trees and noise barriers cannot be combined
en.rus_problem_treesCountry: Country roads cannot have alley trees
en.rus_problem_noTemplate: This road type is not available yet
en.rus_problem_busTramLanes: The outer lanes of this road type cannot carry a bus lane and tram tracks together

zh_TW.rus_tool_description: 選好道路類型與附加升級，再點擊現有道路，一次升級。
zh_TW.rus_roadType_tooltip: 點擊的路段換成這種道路。
zh_TW.rus_busLane_tooltip: 把道路兩側最外側的車道改成公車專用道。
zh_TW.rus_tram_tooltip: 在道路兩側最外側的車道鋪設電車軌道。和公車專用道一起勾選時，兩者在同一條車道。
zh_TW.rus_trees_tooltip: 改用該道路類型的林蔭道版本。鄉村道路沒有林蔭道。
zh_TW.rus_barrier_tooltip: 改用該道路類型的隔音牆版本。
zh_TW.rus_lock_tooltip: 城鎮不會再更新或延伸這條道路。一般升級不會解除原有的鎖定。
zh_TW.rus_problem_treesAndBarrier: 林蔭道與隔音牆不能同時套用
zh_TW.rus_problem_treesCountry: 鄉村道路不能加林蔭道
zh_TW.rus_problem_noTemplate: 目前年份還沒有這種道路
zh_TW.rus_problem_busTramLanes: 這種道路的外側車道無法同時設公車專用道與電車軌道
